inputs.name: results_dir
inputs.label: Results folder
inputs.help: Each run makes a new folder of its own here. Left empty, your default results folder is used.

inputs.name: lfc
inputs.label: Log fold-change file
inputs.help: Per-gene values: a gene id and its log2 fold change on each line.

inputs.name: up
inputs.label: Up threshold
inputs.help: Genes at or above this value are up-regulated. It has no default: set it, or accept a suggestion.

inputs.name: down
inputs.label: Down threshold
inputs.help: Genes at or below this value are down-regulated. It must lie below the up threshold.

inputs.name: network_source
inputs.label: Pathway source
inputs.help: kgml_list merges the pathways of a list; merged_graph reads a network merged before.

inputs.name: kgml_list
inputs.label: Pathway list
inputs.help: The pathways to merge, by id or path. The shipped list names 167 KEGG pathways, found in your KGML folder.

inputs.name: merged_graph
inputs.label: Merged network file
inputs.help: With the merged_graph source: a FuSION network file, or a merged master graph from FuSION 1.

inputs.name: kgml_dir
inputs.label: KGML folder
inputs.help: The folder that holds your KGML files. FuSION ships no KGML.

inputs.name: use_gsea
inputs.label: Shortlist pathways with GSEA
inputs.help: With a pathway list: merge only the pathways that GSEA selects.

inputs.name: gsea_selector
inputs.label: GSEA selector
inputs.help: Which pathways GSEA keeps, such as fdr:0.25.

inputs.name: split_threshold
inputs.label: Node split threshold
inputs.help: A pathway box with more ids than this is split while merging.

inputs.name: not_merged
inputs.label: Ids not to be merged
inputs.help: Optional: a file of gene ids, one per line, that merging keeps apart.

inputs.name: maps
inputs.label: Reference maps
inputs.help: shipped uses the maps installed with FuSION; other uses the files below.

inputs.name: symbols
inputs.label: Symbol map
inputs.help: With other maps: gene ids and their symbols, one pair per line.

inputs.name: pathway_names
inputs.label: Pathway-name map
inputs.help: With other maps: pathway ids and their names, one pair per line.

inputs.name: source
inputs.label: Source node
inputs.help: The gene where signalling paths start, as a bare id such as hsa1956.

inputs.name: target
inputs.label: Target node
inputs.help: The gene where signalling paths end, as a bare id such as hsa3576.

inputs.name: bound
inputs.label: Maximum signalling path length
inputs.help: Paths of at most this many edges are kept.

inputs.name: edges_to_target
inputs.label: Final edges into the target
inputs.help: Which kinds of edge may end a path at the target.

inputs.name: fsc
inputs.label: Node to test for significance
inputs.help: Optional. With one, the solve compares the cases with it (in) and without it (out); without one it runs a single free solve.

inputs.name: node_max
inputs.label: Node relaxations, at most
inputs.help: No default; 8 is offered as a suggestion.

inputs.name: edge_max
inputs.label: Edge relaxations, at most
inputs.help: No default; 8 is offered as a suggestion.

inputs.name: timeout
inputs.label: Per-query timeout
inputs.help: Each solver check may take this long, with a unit: 90s, 50min, 4h. No default; 4h is offered as a suggestion.

inputs.name: budget
inputs.label: Whole-solve budget
inputs.help: Optional: the whole solve stops after this long, keeping what it found.

inputs.name: solutions
inputs.label: Solutions per point
inputs.help: Optional: how many witnesses to keep for each Pareto point.

inputs.name: coexpression_csv
inputs.label: Coexpression CSV file
inputs.help: Optional: coexpression links, which turn the coexpression constraints on with a threshold.

inputs.name: essential_edges
inputs.label: Essential edges file
inputs.help: Optional: edges every path must keep.

inputs.name: avoid_edges
inputs.label: Avoid edges file
inputs.help: Optional: edges no path may use.

inputs.name: nonrelaxed_edges
inputs.label: Non-relaxed edges file
inputs.help: Optional: edges that may not be relaxed.
